title: Deyga Organics in the UK: the brand, the ingredients and where to start
body:
Quick answer: Deyga, often searched as Deyga Organics, is an Indian natural care brand that makes skin, lip, body, foot and hair care with plant-based ingredients, many of which the brand says are grown on its own farm in India. It is best known for its beetroot lip balm, charcoal face wash and zinc oxide sunscreen. Swansura is an official UK partner of Deyga, so you can buy the range from UK stock, with free UK delivery over £40.

Is Deyga the same as Deyga Organics?

Yes. Deyga and Deyga Organics are the same brand and the same products; you will see both names on packs and online. On our site the range sits under Deyga.

What makes Deyga different?

The clearest way to understand any brand is its ingredient lists, and Deyga's are unusually readable:

  • Short lists. The Beetroot Lip Balm has seven ingredients and the Pure Rose Water Toner two: rose and distilled water.
  • Plant names in Sanskrit. Many lists add the traditional Indian name next to the Latin one, such as Satapatrika for rose, Kanya for aloe and Paldka for beetroot.
  • Plant waters. Several products are built on hydrosols (plant waters): tea tree in the Charcoal Face Wash, citrus in the Vitamin C Foaming Face Wash, rice water in the Rice Water Shampoo.
  • Mild coconut- and corn-derived cleansers such as decyl glucoside and sodium cocoyl glycinate in the washes and shampoos.

Two things worth knowing: some Deyga washes and shampoos list an added fragrance (marked IFRA approved), and several products use nut oils such as almond. The full ingredient list is on every Deyga product page on our site, so you can check before you buy.

Where to start with Deyga

Lips

The Beetroot Lip Balm Classic (from £10.99) is the product most people know Deyga for: a tinted balm with no added fragrance. Our guide Deyga Beetroot Lip Balm: stick or pot compares the two versions and the price per gram. The Soft Lip Combo (£17.99) adds a mint sugar scrub.

Face

  • Oat Milk Face Wash (£12.99): oat milk and kaolin with coconut-derived cleansers.
  • Charcoal Face Wash (from £12.99): coconut-shell charcoal in tea tree hydrosol.
  • Vitamin C Foaming Face Wash (£15.99): ascorbyl glucoside, a stable form of vitamin C, in citrus waters.
  • Pure Rose Water Toner (£11.99): rose and distilled water only.
  • 2% Hyaluronic Acid Serum (£22.99): sodium hyaluronate with aloe, centella and panthenol.
  • Deyga Sunscreen (from £16.99): a zinc oxide sunscreen in SPF 30 or SPF 50, with raspberry, carrot seed and sunflower oils.

Prefer a set? The Best Selling Face Care Kit (£28.99) puts a routine in one box. Our face wash guide and face serum guide help you choose by skin type.

Body and feet

Chocolate Body Butter (£13.99) is cocoa powder, shea butter, almond and jojoba oils and cocoa butter, with no water in the list. Deyga's handmade bath bars, such as Shea Saffron (£15.99), are true soaps made with coconut and olive oils, and the Mini Foot Spa Combo (£35.99) boxes a foot soak, scrub and butter. See our body butter guide, body wash and bath bar guide and foot cream guide.

Hair

Rice Water Shampoo (from £10.99) pairs with Soy Milk Conditioner (from £11.99), made with soybean extract, argan oil and panthenol. The Deyga Hair Care Kit (£36.99) adds Deyga's Hair Growth Oil, a coconut, almond and castor oil blend with amla, bhringraj and hibiscus. Our hair oil guide and natural shampoo guide explain how to use them.

Is Deyga a good brand?

That depends on what you want, and we sell it, so here are the facts rather than a verdict. Deyga publishes full ingredient lists, keeps most of them short and leans on plant oils, butters and hydrosols. It does not suit everyone: some products contain added fragrance or essential oils, several contain nut oils, the lip balms contain beeswax, and the bath bars are true soap. Patch test anything new, and if you have a skin condition, ask a pharmacist or GP first. We do not publish invented reviews; real customer reviews appear on each product page.

Buying Deyga in the UK

  • Genuine stock: Swansura is an official UK partner of Deyga.
  • Ships from the UK: no waiting for an overseas parcel and no import charge on delivery.
  • Delivery: free UK delivery over £40, and £5 off orders over £70 with code SAVE5.
  • Returns: unopened items within 14 days of delivery.

Looking for Deyga alternatives?

Vilvah is the other Indian natural brand we stock as an official UK partner, known for goat milk and botanical care. Read Vilvah in the UK, compare the two in Deyga or Vilvah, or see our Indian skincare in the UK guide. Shop all Deyga or the wider natural skincare range.
summary: Deyga, also known as Deyga Organics, explained for UK shoppers: what the brand makes, how to read its ingredient lists, the products to start with and how to buy it in the UK.
